correctness.rationale: Hub-in and hub-out cases give independent-set complements of each peripheral path, with hub-in all-fort factor H_r and hub-out endpoint-constrained active-petal factor z²H_(r-2). Inclusion-minimality enforces maximal omitted independent sets, forbids both endpoints simultaneously included in hub-containing case and forces exactly one active petal without hub. Weighted recurrences H_r=z(H_(r-1)+H_(r-2)),Q_r=zQ_(r-2)+z²Q_(r-3),E_r=z⁴Q_(r-6) follow path bijections; complements of minimal forts biject to inclusion-maximal failed zero-forcing starts. Independent direct enumeration of all subsets of 10 mixed cycle-bouquets confirmed both polynomials. Infinite family derives from case dissection, not enumeration.
